items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Yeah, the first job I played was with Euless Jean.

ctx.x: Can you tell me about the first job you ever played now? Yeah, the first job I played was with Euless Jean.
He was a trumpet player, a good friend of mine. Yes, I heard him play one time. Yeah, he's the cause I start playing drums, because he played the trumpet and I said, well, I'll play the drums.
